CREATE TABLE EDS.SED_ACCOUNTS
WITH
(
	HEAP, DISTRIBUTION=HASH(ACCOUNTCODE)
)
AS
SELECT ONLINEID
	, ACCOUNTNAME
	, ACCOUNTCODE
	, ACCOUNTTYPE
	, STATUS
	, EMAIL
	, MOBILE
	, SETA
	, MOTHERSMAIDENNAME
	, ERRORMESSAGE
	, LAST6_ACCT_NUM

	, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) AS SCD_START_DATE
	, COALESCE(DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day, CAST('99991231' AS DATE)) AS SCD_END_DATE
	, ISACTIVE
	, CASE WHEN DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day is null then 1 else 0 end as ISLATEST
	, BNK_CODE
	, SOURCE_CODE
	, FILE_NAME
	, insert_dttm

FROM
(
	SELECT ONLINEID
		, ACCOUNTNAME
		, ACCOUNTCODE
		, ACCOUNTTYPE
		, STATUS
		, EMAIL
		, MOBILE
		, SETA
		, MOTHERSMAIDENNAME
		, ERRORMESSAGE
		, LAST6_ACCT_NUM
		, ISACTIVE
		, ISLATEST
		, BNK_CODE
		, SOURCE_CODE
		, FILE_NAME
		, INSERT_DTTM

		, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) START_DATE     
		, Max(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) Over (PARTITION BY ACCOUNTCODE
			ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) ROWS BETWEEN 1 Following AND 1 Following) END_DATE                  				
	FROM
	(
		SELECT ONLINEID
			, ACCOUNTNAME
			, ACCOUNTCODE
			, ACCOUNTTYPE
			, STATUS
			, EMAIL
			, MOBILE
			, SETA
			, MOTHERSMAIDENNAME
			, ERRORMESSAGE
			, LAST6_ACCT_NUM
			, ISACTIVE
			, ISLATEST
			, BNK_CODE
			, SOURCE_CODE
			, FILE_NAME
			, INSERT_DTTM


			, row_number() 
				over( partition by ONLINEID
						, ACCOUNTNAME
						, ACCOUNTCODE
						, ACCOUNTTYPE
						, STATUS
						, EMAIL
						, MOBILE
						, SETA
						, MOTHERSMAIDENNAME
						, ERRORMESSAGE
						, LAST6_ACCT_NUM
						, ISACTIVE
						, ISLATEST
						, BNK_CODE
						, SOURCE_CODE
						, FILE_NAME

					order by insert_dttm DESC) AS SEQ_NO
		FROM BUSC.SED_ACCOUNTS

	) AS TMP
	WHERE SEQ_NO = 1
) AS SCDT2
LEFT JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM
	ON CAST(END_DATE AS INTEGER) = DATE_DIM.DATESK;
